evidence.prereg: research/notes/2026-10-16-Q3b-prereg.md (144 lines, written before any download)
evidence.audit: aster.data.perp_loader.audit_perp_streams(['BTCUSDT']) returns ok=true with 54 partitions per kline stream and 0 post-cutoff rows
schema_validated_against: data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/monthly/premiumIndexKlines/BTCUSDT/1h/... (12-col, header present, premium index small decimal)

data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/BTCUSDT/...-2022-01-01.zip (8-col: create_time, symbol, sum_open_interest, sum_open_interest_value, count_toptrader_long_short_ratio, sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio, count_long_short_ratio, sum_long_short_ratio)

limits.symbols: BTCUSDT only in this pass. ETH/SOL etc. are a 1-line symbol arg in q3b_download_perp.py and reuse every piece (Hive layout, manifest, audit).
limits.metrics_frequency: Daily. F2 (basis-vol carry) will need to upsample to bar_index, or trade at 1d.
limits.open_interest: Captured in metrics.sum_open_interest and sum_open_interest_value (USD). No per-leg taker buy/sell.

ledger.rationale: Q3b is plumbing, not signal. The funding carry trial (F1) and the basis-vol trial (F2) and the OI momentum trial (F3) are the ones that count against the family budget.

downstream_dependencies_unlocked: F1v2 — funding carry, delta-neutral, perp close path materialised, perp_legs="all" (Q3b prerequisite)
F2 — basis-vol carry (uses perp kline + spot close + perp funding)
